lines.text: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree, how lovely are your branches!
While oak and maple trees drop all their leaves, pine trees stay brilliantly green!
Why don't evergreen trees freeze and lose their needles in the snow?
Pine needles are super skinny, so heavy snow slides right off without snapping branches!
Each needle is coated in a thick, waterproof wax called cuticle that locks in water!
Inside their cells, evergreen trees produce natural sugar antifreeze!
This stops winter ice crystals from puncturing delicate plant cells!
Now you know the botanical secret behind O Christmas Tree!
Celebrate nature's wonders and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
